name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Hero
description: Adds a ready-made Hero paragraph type: a two- or one-column banner with a media image, title prefix, title, body text and two shared-component CTA buttons, built on ept_core's EPT Settings and ept_basic_button.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types: Hero provides a Hero paragraph type with a media image, title prefix, title, description text and two call-to-action buttons, in a two-column or one-column layout. It builds on ept_core's shared EPT Settings (spacing, background, container width, overlay) and on ept_basic_button for consistent button styling. Part of the EPT family of standalone paragraph-type modules.
